sentences.text: The evidence does not provide a rate/amount/tenor set for this loan case that matches the question, so the monthly EMI cannot be worked out from the cited documents alone.
The only loan-specific EMI figures in force are for a ₹25,00,000 home loan with 240 monthly instalments and an EMI of ₹21,696, which is different from the case facts you gave.
The withdrawn KFS circular defined EMIs as monthly EPIs, but it is no longer in force on the as-of date.
